text.description_html:
Emtek 7061MSC, Crystal Square Knob with Square Sandcast Rose

Emtek has managed to make the classic clear crystal knobset fresh again with its modern shapes in high fashion finishes. The Modern Square Crystal Knob with Sandcast Square Rose is a beautiful combination of the old world and the new, bringing together the sparkling romance of crystal knobs with the chic look of the square shape. This Crystal Square Knob with Square Sandcast Rose will fit doors that are 1-3/8 inches to 3 inches thick and it has an optional backset for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. Choose from flat black bronze, medium bronze, and white bronze finishes. The Clear Crystal Square Knob with #6 Rosette is suitable for interior doors needing dummy, passage, or privacy functions.

Sandcasting is a process for casting metal in sand molds. The mold is made by packing the sand around a pattern. Molten bronze is then poured into a mold cavity formed out of sand. Each sand mold is used only once. The sand is then recycled for the next piece.

Features of the Clear Crystal Square Knob with #6 Rosette:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Knob is surface mounted (rosette screws to the door's face).
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Sandcast Bronze Square Crystal Knobset with Square Rosette:

  • Knob Material: Crystal
  • Rose Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Knob Length: 2" square
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Steam: 1-1/8"
  • Rose Length: 2-1/2" square
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8 - 3"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Available Functions:

  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door knobs on both sides of the door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside knob will release privacy push button and retract the door latch. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
